changelog:
- Initial release of the "New Contact Hygiene Workflow" skill.
- Provides step-by-step instructions to manually build a HubSpot workflow that enriches and stages every new contact upon creation.
- Ensures new contacts are set to "Lead," and copies company name and industry from the associated company.
- Outlines limitations of the HubSpot Workflows API and explains why workflow must be built in the UI.
- Details three workflow-building options: manual UI build (recommended), HubSpot Breeze AI (with critical caveats), and Claude Anthropic Chrome extension.
- Includes testing, verification, workflow rollback steps, and covers edge cases.
